custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a part, part A, at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154837-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154837-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The first two fields are Description, holding part A's description, and Part Number, holding part A's number.
  • Both are plain text boxes, with no edit button and no Confirm or Cancel buttons beside them.

Step 3:

  • The cursor is at the end of the part number.

Step 4:

  • Part Number takes the X straight away: it reads part A's number followed by X.

Step 5:

  • The cursor is at the end of the description.

Step 6:

  • Description takes the X straight away.

Step 7:

  • The window closes without saving.

Step 8:

  • The fields read part A's description and number again, without the X.
